title: LoginRewards
description:
🎁 Daily Login Rewards
Keep players active with daily rewards..
body:
DailyRewards is a lightweight and customizable Minecraft Paper plugin that rewards players for joining the server daily. Players can claim rewards every 24 hours, build reward streaks, and earn special bonuses for consistent activity.
The plugin features a modern GUI, configurable rewards, streak tracking, customizable messages, sound and particle effects, and Vault economy support. Server owners can easily configure rewards using commands or economy balances, making it suitable for Survival, SMP, Lifesteal, and Community servers.
Key Features: • Daily reward claiming system • Reward streak tracking • Configurable rewards and messages • Modern inventory GUI • Vault economy support • Sound and particle effects • First join rewards • PlaceholderAPI support • Lightweight and optimized performance • Easy setup and customization
DailyRewards helps improve player retention and encourages players to return to your server every day. :::
